DeepSeekAdapter — ProviderPort for DeepSeek API (api.deepseek.com).

API endpoint: https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions Auth: Bearer token via Authorization header. Format: OpenAI-compatible request format.

DeepSeek-specific quirk:

  • Response includes a reasoning field containing chain-of-thought that is NOT exposed to the user (CompletionResponse has no field for it).
  • Streaming via SSE is supported.
